unit: Share of India's basmati export total (%), as published by APEDA
source_name: APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority) — Basmati Rice product page, exports 2025-26
notes: PRIMARY SOURCE — APEDA's own Basmati Rice page (retrieved 2026-09-30): 'The country has exported 6.52 million MTs of Basmati Rice to the world during the year 2025-26, valued at Rs. 50,138.28 Crores/ US$ 5.67 billion. Major Export Destinations (2025-26): Saudi Arabia (16.6%), Iran (13.9%), Iraq (11.2%), UAE (8.2%), Yemen (5.7%), and USA (5.0%).' APEDA publishes destination shares, not per-country dollar values, so no per-country USD value is shown here and none has been derived. The six named destinations together account for 60.6% of the total; the rest goes to markets outside this list. Basmati is a national 8-digit tariff line within HS 1006 30, so 6-digit WITS/UN Comtrade data for 100630 (which includes non-basmati milled rice) is not a substitute. This file previously cited 2024-25 figures as republished by a rice-trade news site; that secondary citation was replaced with APEDA's primary figures on 2026-09-30.
